questions.question: Following inconclusive legislative elections, Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot was chosen to try to form a coalition government in which country?
questions.explanation: Israeli President Isaac Herzog designated Gadi Eisenkot to attempt building a ruling coalition within 28 days.
questions.context: 2026 Israeli legislative election: Israeli president Isaac Herzog selects Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot to attempt to form a coalition government following inconclusive Knesset elections. Eisenkot will have 28 days to secure sufficient support in the Knesset.

questions.question: Immigration authorities in Colombia announced the expulsion of 80 foreign nationals hailing from which neighbouring country due to suspected criminal activity?
questions.explanation: Colombian authorities expelled 80 citizens of Venezuela over alleged involvement in offences including theft, trafficking, and extortion.
questions.context: Colombia Migration expel 80 Venezuelan nationals suspected of criminal activity, including theft, drug trafficking, and extortion.

questions.question: Sudan's armed forces reported recapturing the town of Iyal Bakhit and shooting down a drone belonging to which opposing group?
questions.explanation: The Sudanese army stated that it took control of Iyal Bakhit in West Kordofan and brought down a drone operated by the Rapid Support Forces.
questions.context: Sudanese civil war > Kordofan campaign: Sudan's armed forces (SAF) says that they have recaptured the West Kordofan town of Iyal Bakhit. Additionally, the SAF also says that they have downed a Rapid Support Forces drone.

questions.question: King Philippe declined to accept the resignation of Prime Minister Bart De Wever, ordering him to continue budget discussions in which country?
questions.explanation: Belgium's monarch rejected the proposed departure of Bart De Wever and directed him to push forward with governmental budget talks.
questions.context: King Philippe of Belgium refuses Bart De Wever's resignation as the prime minister, telling him to continue with budget negotiations.

questions.question: Police in the Netherlands arrested over one hundred demonstrators who occupied the construction site of a planned data centre run by which technology company?
questions.explanation: Dutch police detained between 100 and 200 activists during a demonstration against a Microsoft data facility being constructed in Amsterdam.
questions.context: 2026 European unrest: Between 100 and 200 people are arrested by Dutch police after protesters break into and temporarily occupy a construction site for a Microsoft data center in Sloterdijk, Amsterdam, during an anti-data-center rally.
